title: portable --format json envelope
description:
The envelope every portable command wraps its result in. Versioned by `schema_version`, which consumers pin against rather than against the tool version: a patch release that changes nothing in the output must not look like a breaking change.

The `disclaimer` key is always PRESENT, and null when the command emits no return. Absent and null must not look the same to a consumer.

Every Decimal is a STRING. A JSON number cannot round-trip a decimal, and a consumer parsing one as a float silently loses the guarantee the whole codebase is built on.

schema_version.description: The envelope's version. Pin against this.

portable_version.description: The tool version. Informational; not part of the contract.

command.description: The command that produced this result.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. The only wall-clock value portable emits, and excluded from the content hash for that reason.

as_of.description: The date the result describes. Always explicit, never an implicit 'now'.

data.description: The result. Either a table block or a flat object. `anyOf`, not `oneOf`: a table block is also an object, so requiring exactly one branch could never be satisfied.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems. Rendered to stderr in human formats.

disclaimer.description: Present on any command emitting a return or a tax figure. A FIELD, not a rendered string, so a consumer that drops it has to drop a named key.

decimal.description: A decimal, as canonical text. Never a JSON number.

code.description: Stable. Branch on this, never on the message text.

returnValue.description: A return, with everything needed to label it honestly (PORT-GIPS-H04). There is no shape here that carries a bare number.
